fields.name: maxStepMeters
fields.tooltip: Longest distance one substep may cover. A tick is split so no step is longer: 4 m = 5 substeps at cruise (1000 m/s), 10 at Light Speed. Smaller follows tight geometry (a loop, a ramp) more exactly and costs more queries.

fields.name: maxSubsteps
fields.tooltip: Hard cap on substeps per tick, whatever the speed.

fields.name: groundLayers
fields.tooltip: Layers the ship rides, lands on and hits. Default + ShipGround flies over any ordinary level as it is; a level that shares its physics scene with colliders the ship must never touch (the runner during the city handoff) narrows this to ShipGround alone.

fields.name: pickupsEnabled
fields.tooltip: Take pickups (needs a ShipPickupSweeper on the ship).

fields.name: pickupLayers
fields.tooltip: Layers the pickup sweep looks on. A pickup is anything there with an IShipPickup on it, found by its own collider (trigger or not).

fields.name: attachRange
fields.tooltip: How far below the ride height the probes still find ground. Inside it the ship is held to the surface; past it (for the coyote distance) it lets go.

fields.name: probeHalfExtents
fields.tooltip: Half spacing of the side probes (x) and the nose / tail probes (y), around the centre probe. The plane through them is the ship's up.

fields.name: coyoteMeters
fields.tooltip: Distance the ship keeps flying straight after the probes lose the ground before it counts as a take-off. Bridges seams and small gaps.

fields.name: visualLift
fields.tooltip: Extra cosmetic lift of the model above the physical ride height (which is the ship definition's hover height).

fields.name: magnetic
fields.tooltip: Magnetic hover: the ship holds to whatever surface is under its probes, at any angle — loops, tubes and steep banks are plain geometry. Off = world gravity rules: only surfaces within the ground angle hold, anything steeper needs centripetal load, and a bank pulls the ship downhill.

fields.name: magnetStrength
fields.tooltip: Centripetal pull the magnet can supply over a CREST, m/s². The ship lets go when speed² × curvature exceeds it. 0 = unlimited (never launches off a crest).

fields.name: maxGroundAngle
fields.tooltip: World-gravity mode only: steepest surface, from level, that holds the ship on its own.

fields.name: hullRadius
fields.tooltip: Radius of the hull sweep that finds walls and obstacles, centred on the ship. Must stay below the hover height or it scrapes the floor.

fields.name: climbAngle
fields.tooltip: A surface tilted up to this far from the ship's up is floor (a ramp, a bank) and is climbed; steeper is a wall.

fields.name: wallHitCooldownSeconds
fields.tooltip: Seconds before another wall hit can cost speed / fire feedback.

fields.name: airDistancePerSpeed
fields.tooltip: Metres of air per m/s of take-off speed. A flight's gravity is solved so it lands this far on, at the speed it left with — real 9.81 at 1000 m/s would be a 65 km jump.

fields.name: airDistanceRange
fields.tooltip: Shortest and longest flight, metres, before the ship's jump strength.

fields.name: airControlFactor
fields.tooltip: Steering and dash authority while airborne, 0..1.

fields.name: minAirGravity
fields.tooltip: Gentlest gravity a flight may get, and the gravity of a fall with no ground found below.

fields.name: maxLandAngle
fields.tooltip: Steepest surface, from the ship's up, it can land on. Anything steeper met in the air is a wall.

fields.name: useGuide
fields.tooltip: Take the help of a guide spline when the level has one in reach. Off = always free flight.

fields.name: guideAssist
fields.tooltip: The ship's own share of a guide's assist (multiplied with the guide's). 1 on a full-assist guide = the heading is the line's and the stick strafes, the runner's feel; lower keeps turning in the player's hands and only leans the heading toward the line.

fields.name: guideHeadingResponse
fields.tooltip: How fast a partial assist eases the heading onto the line, 1/s (scaled by the assist). Full assist locks it.

fields.name: guideRefreshMeters
fields.tooltip: Metres flown between full projections onto the guide. In between, the ship's place on the line is advanced by what it flew and the line's tangent is turned by its curvature — no query at all. A projection is the expensive part of a guided substep (a spline-backed track costs ~0.04 ms each, ten substeps a tick at Light Speed); 0 = project every substep.

fields.name: guideSearchSeconds
fields.tooltip: How often a ship with no guide looks for one.

fields.name: dashEnabled
fields.tooltip: Master switch for the lateral dash and its airborne barrel roll.

fields.name: dashCost
fields.tooltip: Share of the meter one dash spends. The recharge time is the ship definition's.

fields.name: dashSinglePress
fields.tooltip: One press is the whole dash gesture (the player's own CONTROLS toggle can also switch this on).

fields.name: dashDoubleTapSeconds
fields.tooltip: Window for the second tap of a double-tap dash.

fields.name: stallGraceSeconds
fields.tooltip: Seconds at a standstill with the throttle released before the ship reports itself stopped. Braking to a stop alone never stalls it. The report is only a signal (a game may end its run on it): the ship itself keeps flying.

fields.name: recoveryEnabled
fields.tooltip: Falling off the world and coming back (needs a ShipRecovery on the ship). Off = a lost ship just keeps falling.

fields.name: groundlessSeconds
fields.tooltip: Seconds in the air with NO ground anywhere below before the ship counts as lost. A jump always has ground under it.

fields.name: maxAirSeconds
fields.tooltip: Longest the ship may stay airborne at all, ground below or not.

fields.name: useKillHeight
fields.tooltip: Treat anything below the kill height as lost.

fields.name: fallGravity
fields.tooltip: Gravity of the tumbling fall.

fields.name: fallDurationSeconds
fields.tooltip: How long the fall is watched before the ship is put back.

fields.name: respawnWaitSeconds
fields.tooltip: Blinking standstill before the relaunch — or, with a rolling start, the blinking untouchable window after it.

fields.name: respawnRollingStart
fields.tooltip: ON: relaunched at once at the penalised speed, under control, and the wait is spent blinking and untouchable while it flies. OFF: a blinking standstill for the wait, then the relaunch.

fields.name: respawnSpeedPenalty
fields.tooltip: Share of the speed it fell with that the relaunch loses.

fields.name: respawnClearance
fields.tooltip: Guided respawn: plain road the guide must find ahead of the spot.

fields.name: respawnBackMeters
fields.tooltip: Free respawn: how far back along its own trail the ship is put, so it is clear of what it fell off.

fields.name: respawnLookAheadMeters
fields.tooltip: Free respawn: how far along each candidate heading the ship looks for road. It faces the way with the most road ahead, so it never relaunches at the edge it fell off.

fields.name: respawnCentreSearchMeters
fields.tooltip: Free respawn: how far to each side the road's edges are searched for, to put the ship in the middle of it. A side with no edge inside this range is open ground: the ship is not moved that way.

fields.name: crumbSpacingMeters
fields.tooltip: Free respawn: distance between the breadcrumbs the ship drops while safely grounded.

fields.name: maxCrumbTilt
fields.tooltip: Free respawn: a breadcrumb is only dropped while the ship is within this tilt of upright — never halfway up a loop.

fields.name: reverseSpeed
fields.tooltip: At a standstill, holding the brake backs the ship up to this speed — the way out of a wall it has nosed into. 0 = no reverse (the runner's rule: the brake only stops).

fields.name: ghostMaterial
fields.tooltip: Material of the dash ghosts and of the respawn blink. Empty = a runtime translucent fallback.

fields.name: dashGhostLifetime
fields.tooltip: How long a dash ghost lives.

fields.name: dashGhostStartAlpha
fields.tooltip: A dash ghost's alpha when dropped; it fades to zero from there.

fields.name: dashGhostDriftMeters
fields.tooltip: How far a ghost slides back behind the ship over its life. 0 = a pure staircase.

fields.name: respawnBlinkRate
fields.tooltip: Blinks per second while the ship waits to relaunch after a fall.

fields.name: barrelRollTrailSeconds
fields.tooltip: How long a wingtip ribbon of the barrel roll lives.

fields.name: barrelRollTrailSpan
fields.tooltip: Where the ribbons leave the wing, as a share of the model's half width.

fields.name: barrelRollTrailMaterial
fields.tooltip: Must be URP Particles/Unlit, additive — the plain Unlit ignores the trail's gradient. Empty = a runtime fallback.

fields.name: maxYawRate
fields.tooltip: Fastest the ship can turn with no guide spline, at low speed.

fields.name: turnAuthority
fields.tooltip: Share of the ship's grip a full-lock turn may ask for. At speed the turn rate is grip ÷ speed: 1 = exactly what holds, above 1 = full lock slides (brake first).

fields.name: freeStrafeShare
fields.tooltip: Share of the definition's lateral (strafe) speed that steering also gets with no guide. 0 = pure turning, 1 = the runner's full strafe on top of the turn.
